displayName: 风箱袋鼠跃跃 Bellows Kangaroo Hop
description: Original Bellows Kangaroo Hop, a peach-and-mint biomimetic toy-robot companion. Its original choreography uses covered accordion-knee compression, paired-foot hops, tail counterbalance and careful blank-card balancing. Movement principles are animal-inspired; this is not official or replicated industrial hardware.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
